entities.name: service
entities.description: The application, product, component, or service being deployed.

entities.name: environment
entities.description: The deployment environment such as production, staging, or test.

intents.name: billing_duplicate_charge
intents.description: A customer reports two identical charges, a duplicate card payment, or being billed twice for one order. Not a general invoice correction or plan change.

intents.name: production_deploy
intents.description: A request to release, ship, publish, or deploy a software build or service to production or prod. Not a request to deploy only to staging or test.

intents.name: cold_chain_alert
intents.description: A facility, freezer, refrigerator, warehouse, or cold-chain temperature excursion or sensor alert, including a reading above or below a safe limit.

intents.name: suspicious_login
intents.description: A report of an unknown, unrecognized, anomalous, or suspicious account login or sign-in, including a new device or location.

intents.name: cancellation_request
intents.description: A request to cancel, close, terminate, or stop renewal of a subscription, service, account, or order. Not a request to change plans.

intents.name: unknown
intents.description: Unsupported, ambiguous, or unrelated operational content that does not clearly match billing duplication, production deployment, temperature alert, suspicious login, or cancellation.
